checks.name: quick open › Today’s note makes today’s note under a Daily notes page and opens it
Today’s note again and the shortcut pressed three times fast open the same note; no second note
Previous day shows “No note for …” and creates nothing until Create; Create makes it in date order; Next day opens today
after renaming Daily notes the press reuses it: no new parent, no new day
a deleted day note is replaced by a new one on the next press; the deleted one stays in Deleted notes
a profile switch during Create puts nothing in the other profile; back home the day has at most one note

limits: One Mac, from source under Electron on the carried runtime; the date is the machine’s local date during the run.
